steps.note: Set the escalation timeout to the minimum permitted value and verify the tenant accepts it.

args.goal: As the Tenant Admin, configure Condition-Based Triggering to create an approval that remains pending, wait until the one-hour escalation timeout is reached, and stop on the approval screen showing that it was automatically escalated to the next level.

steps.note: Exercise the approval workflow and directly observe that a pending approval is auto-escalated after exactly one hour.
Confirm the resulting approval screen is rendered without errors or unresolved data.
